benefits.titleZh: 談論稍後再次聯絡某人
benefits.titleEn: Talk about making another attempt to contact somebody
benefits.zh: try back 可以表示稍後再次致電或聯絡某人。
benefits.en: Try back lets you explain that you will phone or contact somebody again later.

benefits.zh: try for 可以表示努力爭取工作、職位、獎項或其他目標。
benefits.en: Try for lets you talk about attempting to get a job, position, prize or other goal.

benefits.titleZh: 談論衣物、產品和新構思
benefits.titleEn: Talk about clothes, products and new ideas
benefits.zh: 你可以 try clothes on 試穿衣物，也可以 try products, games or ideas out，先試用產品、遊戲或構思，再作決定。
benefits.en: You can try clothes on and try products, games or ideas out before making a decision.

benefits.zh: try out for 和 try-out 可用來談論球隊、樂隊和表演選拔；try it on with somebody 則可描述某人試探另一人的底線。
benefits.en: Try out for and try-out are useful when talking about teams, bands and performances. Try it on with somebody describes a person testing another person’s limits.

questions.prompt: Mia put on the blue jacket to see whether it fitted before buying it.

questions.prompt: Daniel will attempt to get the job at the new café.
questions.promptZh: 丹尼爾會嘗試爭取新咖啡店的那份工作。

questions.answerZh: 丹尼爾會爭取新咖啡店的那份工作。

questions.prompt: We tested the new board game after dinner to see whether it was fun.
